code.description: The authorization code received from the authorization server.

code_verifier.description: PKCE parameters (if the client used PKCE during the authorization request)

code_challenge.description: PKCE parameters (RFC 7636) for public clients and enhanced security

oneOf.description:
The method used to derive the code challenge (e.g., "S256" or "plain").
only required if `code_challenge` is present. "S256" is strongly recommended in OAuth 2.1 for better security.

redirect_uri.description: redirect URI is optional if the client has only one registered redirect URI

resource.description: Audience parameter (RFC 8707) to specify the intended recipients of the token.

authorization_endpoint.description:
URL of the authorization endpoint.
REQUIRED unless no grant types use it.

code_challenge_methods_supported.description: PKCE code challenge methods supported (S256 is strongly recommended in 2.1).

grant_types_supported.description:
List of supported grant types.
In OAuth 2.1: authorization_code, client_credentials, refresh_token (no implicit/password).

introspection_endpoint.description: URL of the token introspection endpoint (RFC 7662).

introspection_endpoint_auth_methods_supp.description: Client authentication methods supported by the introspection endpoint.

introspection_endpoint_auth_signing_alg_.description: JWS signing algorithms supported for JWT auth at the introspection endpoint.

issuer.description:
REQUIRED. The authorization server's issuer identifier.
URL using https scheme with no query or fragment.

jwks_uri.description: URL of the JWK Set document containing the server's public keys.

op_policy_uri.description: URL for the authorization server's policy on client use of data.

op_tos_uri.description: URL for the authorization server's terms of service.

pushed_authorization_request_endpoint.description: List of supported revocation endpoint authentication signing algorithms (additional).

registration_endpoint.description: URL of the Dynamic Client Registration endpoint.

require_pkce.description: Whether the server requires PKCE for all clients (OAuth 2.1 best practice).

response_modes_supported.description:
List of supported response_mode values.
Defaults to ["query", "fragment"] if omitted.

response_types_supported.description:
REQUIRED. List of supported response_type values.
In OAuth 2.1 this should primarily be ["code"].

revocation_endpoint.description: URL of the token revocation endpoint (RFC 7009).

revocation_endpoint_auth_methods_support.description: Client authentication methods supported by the revocation endpoint.

revocation_endpoint_auth_signing_alg_val.description: JWS signing algorithms supported for JWT auth at the revocation endpoint.

scopes_supported.description: RECOMMENDED. List of supported OAuth 2.0 scope values.

token_endpoint.description:
URL of the token endpoint.
REQUIRED in most cases (especially for OAuth 2.1).

token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported.description: List of client authentication methods supported by the token endpoint.

token_endpoint_auth_signing_alg_values_s.description:
JWS signing algorithms supported for JWT client authentication
at the token endpoint (private_key_jwt, client_secret_jwt).

ui_locales_supported.description: Languages and scripts supported for the user interface (BCP 47).

application.description: Unique identifier for the application (assigned by the authorization server).

client_id.description: Unique identifier for the client application (assigned by the authorization server).

client_id_issued_at.description: Time at which the client identifier was issued (Unix timestamp).

client_name.description: Human-readable name of the client application.

client_secret.description: Optional or required depending on registration type (Public vs Confidential).

client_secret_expires_at.description: Time at which the client secret will expire (0 or None for no expiration).

client_uri.description: URL of the home page of the client.

contacts.description: Array of email addresses for people responsible for this client.

logo_uri.description: URL that references a logo for the client application.

policy_uri.description: URL for the application's privacy policy.

software_id.description: A unique identifier string assigned by the software issuer.

software_statement.description: A digitally signed JWT assertion containing verifiable client metadata.

software_version.description: A version identifier string string assigned by the software issuer.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description:
Requested authentication method for the token endpoint
(e.g., `client_secret_basic`, `client_secret_post`, `private_key_jwt`).

tos_uri.description: URL for the application's terms of service.

CodeChallengeMethod.description:
PKCE code challenge methods (RFC 7636).
the `plain` method is not included as it is not recommended in OAuth 2.1 due to security weaknesses. Only `S256` is supported for better security.

ErrorResponse.description:
Standard OAuth 2.0 error response structure (RFC 6749 Section 5.2).
should match fields from crates/model/src/contract/error_response.rs

ResponseType.description:
Valid OAuth 2.0 response types for the authorization endpoint.
we do not support the `token` or `id_token` response type (implicit flow) as it is not recommended in OAuth 2.1 and has security weaknesses.

TokenEndpointAuthMethod.description: Client token endpoint authentication methods (RFC 7591 / OIDC).

access_token.description: The access token issued by the authorization server.

expires_in.description: The lifetime in seconds of the id/access token.

iss.description: The identifier of the authorization server that issued the token.

oneOf.description: The refresh token, which can be used to obtain new access tokens using the same authorization grant.

refresh_token_expires_in.description: The lifetime in seconds of the refresh token.

scope.description: The scope of the access token as described by the authorization server.

token_type.description: The type of the token issued.

200.description: Revoked all client signing keys and local private material

parameters.description: redirect URI is optional if the client has only one registered redirect URI
parameters.name: redirect_uri

parameters.description: Audience parameter (RFC 8707) to specify the intended recipients of the token.
parameters.name: resource

parameters.description: PKCE parameters (RFC 7636) for public clients and enhanced security
parameters.name: code_challenge

parameters.description:
The method used to derive the code challenge (e.g., "S256" or "plain").
only required if `code_challenge` is present. "S256" is strongly recommended in OAuth 2.1 for better security.
parameters.name: code_challenge_method

403.description: Caller is not permitted to validate tokens
